content.title: The God Delusion debate — unofficial transcript
content.author: John Lennox · Richard Dawkins · hosted by The Singju Post
content.note: Unofficial transcript. Fixed Point Foundation, which held the debate, published the recording but no transcript can be found from it (searched 2026-11-28), so this third-party text is not authoritative; check quotations against the recording. Speaker-attributed transcript arranged around six theses and concluding statements. Published as a full transcript; not independently aligned word for word with the recording. Documentary use only; the participants are not doctrinal authorities for this library. Read both speakers in context.
content.role: Primary record · not a teaching authority
